newsitem.title: USA: Substance Abuse limits U.S. Drug unit funds.
newsitem.headline: Substance Abuse limits U.S. Drug unit funds.

text.p: Substance Abuse Technologies Inc said its board has voted to limit continued funding for its U.S. Drug Testing Inc unit and approved a new budget for the subsidiary.

In a release following Friday's announcement that Substance Abuse had shut its West Coast operations, the company said its U.S. Drug unit will seek financing by a venture capitalist or a strategic partner so that it can continue to work on developing a saliva-based drug test.
The company also said it had sold $344,663 in fixed assets to U.S. Drug in exchange for U.S. Drug shares valued at a per share conversion rate of $1.25.
U.S. Drug has been listed on the Pacific Stock Exchange but is currently not traded.
